kept or dropped (backend/signal_test.py: A company's first Form 4 filing in 30 days that reports an open-market purchase of its shares on a form naming an officer and no ten percent holder
column8: Found on 2026-11-23 after about a dozen cuts of the SEC's bulk Form 4 files (officers, directors, ten percent holders, size, period). On the book's names, before costs: 107 events, 37 companies, median +9.6% against XBI at six months, 58% ahead of XBI against 44% for the placebo, t 2.9 by month. Weak before 2022. Through the harness the same day, after one spread a round trip: t 2.8 by month and 2.3 by company with no liquidity floor, 2.4 and 2.1 at $250,000 traded a day, 1.7 and 1.1 at $1m, 0.3 and 0.6 at $5m. So it does not reach the searched bar of 3 at any floor, and what there is sits in shares too thin to trade in size. Then repeated outside the book the same night, on the constituents of the XBI fund from its 14 half-yearly holdings reports (2019-12-31 to 2026-06-30) that are not in the book and have prices, 157 companies. While a fund member: 100 events on 55 companies, median -8.1% against XBI at six months, 40% ahead of XBI against 41% for the placebo, t -2.4 by month after costs. Over all dates since 2016: 435 events on 103 companies, 43% against 42%. No horizon and no liquidity floor changes it, and that sample holds only companies still listed, which flatters the rule. Dropped: what showed on the book's own names was the book's hindsight
